result.summary: The page appears visually intact with no critical or major issues. Minor layout and styling observations include truncated text in restaurant cards and a potentially clipped category filter list.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated, indicating the text does not fit within the card width.
issues.suggestion: Consider using a smaller font size, allowing multi-line text, or ensuring the horizontal scroll container provides enough width to display full names.

issues.description: The category filter list (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears to be cut off on the right edge, suggesting there are more categories not immediately visible without horizontal scrolling, which may not be obvious to users.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual cue (like a fade or arrow) on the right edge to indicate more categories are available via horizontal scroll.
